LanguageData.NormalizeChanceToBaselineCooldown: Normalise OS chance to baseline cooldown:
LanguageData.NormalizationExplanation:
Since OS chances are rolled per attack, faster weapons benefit disproportionally from OS strikes.
This setting averages overall amount of OS all weapons do to baseline cooldown's value.
Faster weapons will have a lot of low chances to trigger OS, and slow weapons will have small number of high chances
